data.promptProse: Soft clinic lamps frame adult Taihou seated alone astride a padded examination stool. Her nurse dress is unbuttoned and pulled below bare breasts, while black stockings tighten around folded thighs. She grips the stool back with one hand and fingers herself beneath the lifted hem with the other, red ribbon straps trailing safely along the seat. Dark twin tails and golden eyes hold feverish devotion through tears and a lush blush. Vertical single-subject portrait, no text or extra people.
